quote: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
speaker: Allah ﷻ

quote: So remember Me; I will remember you.
speaker: Allah ﷻ

quote: The example of one who remembers his Lord and one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
speaker: The Prophet ﷺ

quote: For everything there is a polish, and the polish of the heart is the remembrance of Allah.
speaker: The Prophet ﷺ

quote: I am as My servant thinks I am. I am with him when he remembers Me. If he remembers Me in himself, I remember him in Myself.
speaker: Allah ﷻ (Hadith Qudsi)

quote: Dhikr begins on the tongue, descends into the heart, then into the secret, then into the soul, then into the hidden — until nothing remains but the Remembered.
speaker: Ibn Ata'illah al-Iskandari

quote: Do not abandon the remembrance because you do not feel the presence of Allah in it. For your heedlessness of His remembrance is worse than your heedlessness within His remembrance.
speaker: Ibn Ata'illah al-Iskandari

quote: Dhikr is the dislodging of heedlessness from the field of the heart by the perpetual presence of the Real.
speaker: Ibn Ata'illah al-Iskandari

quote: The heart rusts as iron and copper rust, and its polish is the remembrance of Allah, and reciting the Quran.
speaker: Imam al-Ghazali

quote: Persist in remembrance until the tongue is silent and the heart speaks. Then the heart becomes silent, and only the Beloved remains.
speaker: Imam al-Ghazali

quote: In the heart there are wounds that nothing closes but turning to Allah; and rusts that nothing polishes but His remembrance.
speaker: Ibn al-Qayyim

quote: Dhikr is to the heart what water is to the fish — see what becomes of the fish when it leaves the water.
speaker: Ibn al-Qayyim

quote: If you knew the reward of dhikr, you would not let your tongue rest from it for a single breath.
speaker: Ibn al-Qayyim

quote: The one who remembers Allah amid the heedless is like a green tree amid dry ones.
speaker: Ibn al-Qayyim

quote: Whoever loves a thing remembers it often. Whoever claims to love Allah without remembering Him — his claim is false.
speaker: Imam al-Junayd

quote: The sincere dhikr is when the one remembering forgets himself in the remembrance, and forgets the remembrance in the Remembered.
speaker: Imam al-Junayd

quote: Every breath that leaves the body without the remembrance of Allah is a death; and every breath drawn in His presence is a life.
speaker: Shaykh Ahmad al-Sirhindi

quote: The lata'if of the heart are lamps. Dhikr is the flame that lights them, one by one, until the whole inner sky is luminous.
speaker: Shaykh Ahmad al-Sirhindi

quote: Silence is the language of God; all else is poor translation. In the dhikr of the heart, the tongue grows still and the soul begins to speak.
speaker: Mawlana Jalal ad-Din Rumi

quote: You think you are the one calling 'Allah' — but His call is in your call. The longing in your dhikr is His answer reaching you before your word leaves your lips.
speaker: Mawlana Jalal ad-Din Rumi

quote: Truly, the remembrance of Allah is the greatest.
speaker: Allah ﷻ
